description: Send one viewing or question enquiry through MCP only after the person explicitly authorizes sending the reviewed details to the exact catalog team returned by prepare_findestate_enquiry_request, including its configured service email or CRM. Requires that prepared intent, the person's supplied name and at least one phone/email, consent:true with the returned consentVersion, and submissionConfirmed:true. Never infer consent from wanting a viewing, a card click or previously supplied contacts. Ask when a requested time or time zone is ambiguous; preferredAt must be a future UTC instant within 366 days, or omitted. QUESTION needs a message and no preferredAt. The server rechecks the immutable target and current publication, then commits the native inbox entry and configured delivery jobs atomically. A successful contact-free receipt proves the request is registered; it does not verify contacts, email/CRM delivery or an appointment. After an uncertain outcome never automatically retry or prepare a replacement intent; an explicitly requested retry must use the identical intent and normalized payload. Do not expose the intent, repeat full contacts in the acknowledgement, read private enquiries, reserve property, collect payment or confirm a calendar slot.

submissionConfirmed.description: True only after the person explicitly authorizes sending the reviewed enquiry and contact details to this selected catalog team, including its configured service email or CRM. Wanting a viewing alone is not this confirmation.

name: submit_findestate_enquiry_request
title: Send a FindEstate enquiry request
